$comment: Reference findings for the lab 06 exercise PR (fixtures/price-drift-fix.patch, PR #26 on branch lab06/price-drift-fix). Facilitator-authored on 22 Oct 2026 from the diff and confirmed by running tests on a throwaway branch; it is not a Devin Review export. The Devin Review run on PR #26 (22 Oct 2026, commit 42ad09b) reported F1, F2, F5, a goodwill-price validation bug and a payments-reviewer flag, but not F3; see answer.md. Use it when you cannot run Devin Review yourself, and compare it with your own review when you can.

findings.title: Price override is gated on a client-chosen role
findings.reasoning: `req.caller.role` comes from the `X-Kade-Role` request header (`services/api/src/middleware/auth.ts`), so any shopper who sends `X-Kade-Role: merchandiser` with `priceOverrides` sets their own price.
findings.verified: On the PR branch a Lumen customer with X-Kade-Role: merchandiser and priceOverrides {"LH-LAMP-05": "0.01"} gets a 201 with unit price 0.01 USD and order total 7.96 USD (0.01 + 7.95 shipping).

findings.title: Per-line rounding truncates instead of rounding
findings.reasoning: 19.90 × 2 × 100 is 3979.9999999999995 in IEEE-754, so `Math.floor` gives 39.79. The comment says it matches the fulfilment worker, but the worker uses Decimal with banker's rounding, not truncation.
findings.verified: 2 × TS-SOCK-01-M checks out at subtotal 39.79 EUR on the PR branch and 39.80 EUR on main. 3 × TS-SOCK-01-M is unaffected (59.70 on both), which is why a three-sock spot check misses it.

findings.title: Two extra queries per cart line inside the checkout transaction
findings.reasoning: The loop runs after the inventory reservation updates, so the transaction holds those row changes while it issues 2 × lines more statements. Correct, but it lengthens the transaction on the busiest days.
findings.disputed_by_author: Carts are capped in practice, two extra queries a line is nothing, and this is a flag, not a bug.

findings.title: Un-skipped planted test turns a course plant into a passing test
findings.reasoning: Correct on the branch, but merging it would remove the plant from main, which the course forbids. Informational: it is evidence for the fix, not a reason to merge.

findings.title: Review rule targets only src/money.ts
findings.reasoning: The PR adds the rule and then rounds money in `src/routes/checkout.ts`, so the rule's own condition never matches this PR. A rule the PR can edit and walk around does not protect totals.
